body.heading: Unbundle the skill
paragraphs: 'Learn guitar' sounds like one thing, but it is really chords, rhythm, finger strength, reading music and a dozen other pieces. Each piece is small enough to practise on its own, and progress in one makes the others easier.
Write the pieces down. A visible map stops the discouragement of feeling like you are 'not getting anywhere' when in fact three of the ten pieces have quietly improved.

body.heading: Practise one piece at a time
paragraphs: Pick the piece that unlocks the most, or the one you enjoy most, and give it your sessions for a week or two. Short, frequent practice beats occasional marathons for almost every skill.
Every so often, put the pieces back together: play the whole song slowly, cook the full meal, hold the real conversation. The pieces exist to serve the whole, and the whole is where the fun lives.

takeaway: Break the skill into pieces, practise one at a time, and keep reassembling the whole.
